install.title: Add %BRAND% to your home screen
install.body: Open it like an app, from your home screen or dock. Your account and settings stay the same.
install.iosSteps: In Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.

push.title: Alerts on this device
push.offBody: Get job alerts and reminders as notifications on this device. Your browser asks for permission first.
push.onBody: Job alerts and reminders also show as notifications on this device.
push.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser's site settings, then try again.
push.unavailable: Alerts on this device can't be turned on for your account right now.
push.turnedOn: Alerts are on for this device.
push.turnedOff: Alerts are off for this device.

admin.title: Announcements
admin.sub: "What's new" notes shown once to each person, at most one at a time. Publishing needs every language the site offers.
admin.missingCount: {count, plural, one {# language missing} other {# languages missing}}
admin.confirmDelete: Delete "{key}"? People who have not seen it yet will not see it.
admin.saveFailed: Could not save. Check the form and try again.

form.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores, e.g. 2026-11-assistant
form.audienceHint: The announcement shows only in the languages you tick.
form.datesHint: Leave empty to start now and run for 30 days.
form.priorityHint: Lower numbers show first when two are live.
form.flags: Feature switches that must be on (comma-separated)

form.partial: Add both a title and a message for {languages}, or clear them.

errors.key_taken: Another announcement already uses this key.
